snippet.title: Full Stride (フルストライド) 1st Trailer
snippet.description:
『Full Stride（フルストライド）』は、騎手独自の視点でレースの緊張感や駆け引きをリアルに再現した、本格ジョッキーレーシングゲームです。

Full Stride is an authentic jockey simulator that captures the high-stakes tension and strategic depth of professional horse racing.

▶ Wishlist on Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4181970/Full_Stride

▶ Support on Patreon : https://www.patreon.com/cw/FullStride
